items.title: FlowGenius — AI-Assisted Accounts Payable
items.description: An invoice-to-payment platform with AI-extracted invoice data, role-based approvals and tamper-evident audit trails.

details.overview: Built in a 10-day hackathon sprint leading a team of 7, FlowGenius is an end-to-end accounts-payable platform covering AI-extracted invoice data, role-based access across 5 roles (Requestor, AP, HOD, Verifier, SuperAdmin) and dual-control payment verification.
highlights: Multi-stage payment state machine (Draft → Submitted → AP → HOD Approval → Payment Marked → Verified) across 13 .NET controllers and Razor screens.
Same-person verification guard enforcing segregation of duties, plus an immutable audit hash chain capturing 8 event types.
AI invoice extraction with per-field confidence scoring and an AI Quality Dashboard tracking accuracy and P95 latency.
Hangfire background jobs powering extraction and metrics.

items.title: ASAP Semiconductor Ecosystem
items.description: High-traffic e-commerce platform managing millions of SKUs with real-time quoting, CDN and technical SEO.

details.overview: Led development of high-traffic modules of a semiconductor e-commerce platform architected to manage millions of SKUs and generate real-time quotes for international buyers.
highlights: Global CDN strategy for static content — 30% lower server load and faster international page loads.
Reduced cloud egress and data-transfer costs through response optimization.
Technical SEO with Schema markup, Core Web Vitals improvements and Server-Side Rendering (SSR).
Scalable architecture built for high concurrency and large catalogs.

items.title: Virtual Advisor CRM
items.description: A CRM system facilitating customer relationship management, sales processes and internal workflows.

details.overview: Virtual Advisor is a CRM platform built for client Nextek, supporting customer relationship management, sales pipelines and internal team workflows, alongside sister products Generation Vault and Campaign Builder.
highlights: Built, maintained and enhanced core system modules for performance and scalability.
Improved user experience across sales and workflow tools.
Part of a wider product suite serving business operations.

items.title: Gas Distribution Management System
items.description: Cylinder inventory, customer orders, delivery tracking and billing for a gas distributor.

details.overview: A personalized management system for Wright Brothers Global Gas that optimized administration of cylinder inventory, customer orders, delivery tracking and billing.
highlights: Automation solutions that reduced manual work.
Improved customer-service efficiency.
End-to-end order and billing lifecycle management.

items.title: WASA Tubewell & Filtration Automation
items.description: Web-based monitoring and automation systems for water tubewells and filtration plants with 3D HMI views.

details.overview: Two automation systems for WASA (Water & Sanitation Authority): a tubewell monitoring system and a filtration-plant supervision interface, both replacing manual monitoring effort.
highlights: Real-time dashboards and reports for voltage, current, frequency and motor status.
3D HMI visualization of live plant parameters.
Fault-detection notifications for power failures and inactive tubewells.
Chlorine concentration, tank status and water-flow supervision with alarm modules.

items.title: Intelligent Home Automation System
items.description: AI-powered home automation with 3D-CNN facial recognition and remote appliance control.

details.overview: Final-year project: an AI-powered home automation system with two modules — a smart door and smart appliances — incubated at Nspire (Netsol) after a pitch at the Plan9 Incubation Center.
highlights: Smart Door: facial recognition using a 3D Convolutional Neural Network (3D-CNN) to authenticate and unlock doors for registered users.
Smart Appliances: Android app and C# web interface for remote control of home electronics.
Hardware–software integration for seamless automation.
Entrepreneurship: user surveys, cost estimation and market feasibility; secured startup incubation.

items.title: Failure Modes & Recovery in LLM Tool-Calling
items.description: MSc research studying how LLM tool-calling pipelines fail and how they can recover.

details.overview: Ongoing MSc (Artificial Intelligence) research at UET investigating failure modes in LLM tool-calling pipelines and strategies for detecting and recovering from them.
highlights: Cataloguing common failure modes in tool-augmented LLM systems.
Designing recovery and self-correction strategies.
Building evaluation harnesses to measure reliability.
